info.description: One page of the MYRA STEM Lab newsletter — the scan, and what it shows. ⚠ THE ORDER OF THESE ROWS IS THE ORDER ON THE PAGE, and the rail numbers itself from it ("page 3 of 5"), so dragging a row renumbers the caption too. ⚠ `alt` IS NOT OPTIONAL AND IS NOT THE TITLE. It describes what is ON the scan for a reader who cannot see it. The school’s own widget ships all five with empty alt; these were written for this site and should stay written.
